content.short: A Web3 infrastructure provider offering mining modules, validators, startup kits, and AI Drops.
content.description: Precipitate Protocol provides infrastructure-as-a-service for Web3 across four core categories: mining modules that allow participants to earn rewards without owning hardware; validators that enable users to contribute to networks; startup kits that include web hosting, SSL certificates, domain names, and virtual private servers; and AI Drops that grant access to powerful Nvidia GPUs. All components are powered by AI and accessible through permissionless, private payments.
content.meta: Precipitate Protocol provides Web3 infrastructure as a service. Discover Precipitate Protocol and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Infrastructure Between AI and Chains
resources.tldr: Virtual servers tuned for AI workloads that also hold node access, so a dapp can reach both without stitching them together.
